Parse the formula for ngme function

Source: R/ngme.R
ngme_parse_formula.Rd

Parse the formula for ngme function

Usage

ngme_parse_formula(
  fm,
  data,
  control_ngme,
  noise,
  group,
  replicate,
  prior_beta,
  standardize
)

Arguments

fm

formula

data

data.frame

control_ngme

control_ngme

noise

noise

group

group factor

replicate

replicate vector

prior_beta

prior specification for fixed effects

standardize

logical, whether fixed effects are standardized

Value

a list (replicate) of ngme_replicate models
